en: A black-and-white nighttime cityscape featuring a waterfront and park area, with a city skyline illuminated in the background. Visible are distinctive old European-style buildings, prominent spires, and domes. The foreground shows a large, mostly empty square with a few cars, bordered by trees and well-lit streets. The overall atmosphere evokes a serene urban scene by a body of water.
